subtitle: Private, offline AI assistant
promo: Now free, with new Qwen3.5 and Gemma 4 models. Chat, talk, record meetings, translate and hear what your camera sees, all on your device, even in airplane mode.
whatsnew:
Ask for the time or the date and you now get the real one from your iPhone. Small models used to make one up.

Answers come in the language you write in, also when you ask about a photo.

Asked who someone is, the smallest models now say when they don't know the person instead of inventing a life story, and AiGoodbye always says correctly who made it.

With larger text, the chat title no longer sits on top of the answer, the chat list in the menu has room again, and its rows are bigger and easier to tap.

The screen stays on while a model downloads, so the download no longer crawls when the phone locks, and the progress says clearly that the model is downloading.

Thank you to everyone who tested and wrote in, especially for the detailed reports.
description:
Your private AI that lives on your device. Free, with no cloud, no accounts and no ads.

AiGoodbye runs powerful AI models entirely on your iPhone and iPad. Talk to it, record a meeting, translate a conversation, scan a document or point the camera at the world. Nothing you type, say or show it ever leaves your device.

TALK
- Hands-free voice conversations, fully offline
- Interrupt any time; it listens again on its own

RECORD MEETINGS
- Transcribes on your device as you speak, for hours
- One tap for a summary with key points and action items
- Keeps going with the screen locked; nothing is uploaded

TRANSLATE
- Two-way spoken translation between 13 languages, offline
- Hands-free mode for real conversations across a table

SEE
- Ask about photos, screenshots and handwritten notes
- Scan paper documents into text
- Describe Surroundings: hear what the camera sees, built for blind and low-vision users

READ YOUR DOCUMENTS
- Ask questions about PDFs and text files
- A private Knowledge Library the AI can draw on in every chat

MAKE IT YOURS
- Personas change how it answers
- Private memory: say "Remember that..." and it stays on this device
- Siri, Shortcuts, widgets, Control Center and the share sheet

PRIVATE BY CONSTRUCTION
- Privacy Center shows what the app connects to, and when
- Face ID lock
- App Privacy label: Data Not Collected

CHOOSE YOUR AI
- Apple Intelligence: instant, no download, on supported devices
- Qwen3 Vision 2B: recommended, understands images, 30+ languages
- Qwen3.5 Vision 4B: the smartest model for iPhone, including iPhone 17 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo
- Qwen3.5 Vision 9B Pro and Gemma 4 E4B: our most capable models, for iPad and Mac
- Also Qwen3.5 Vision 0.8B and 2B, Gemma 4 E2B from Google, Qwen3 Vision 8B and Smol Vision 500M
- Or bring your own model from Hugging Face

COMPLETELY FREE
- Every feature, with no subscriptions, no in-app purchases and no ads

Downloaded models need 0.7 to 6 GB of free space (one-time download, Wi-Fi recommended). Apple Intelligence requires a supported device with Apple Intelligence turned on. AiGoodbye only offers the models your device can run.

Say goodbye to subscriptions, data tracking and cloud dependency. Say hello to AI that is truly yours.
